title: NC-PLUS-TICKFAIL-measure-2026-11-13T13: Add metrics table via D1 migration so tick step measure persists latency/counters
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the backlog item PLUS-TICKFAIL-measure-2026-11-13T13 was parked needs-code by the in-tick doer
**Done check:** cmd:python3 scripts/needs_code_bridge.py --probe PLUS-TICKFAIL-measure-2026-11-13T13
**Status:** closed

Add metrics table via D1 migration so tick step measure persists latency/counters

Backlog done check: metrics table exists in D1 and next tick completes measure without D1_ERROR

Triage: Doer is restricted to the backlog DB only; creating a metrics table/migration on the app database and wiring the tick measure step requires code changes. | first step: Open a repo change to add the D1 migration creating the metrics table and enable the tick measure step, then run a tick and verify no D1_ERROR.

Bridged from the backlog by scripts/needs_code_bridge.py (NEEDS-CODE-BRIDGE-1). The change is code, data or a test that a loop consumes; a document alone does not close it.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 26.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
